units.source_text: “这条腰带花样画得那样花哨，那样鲜艳，我为它的无比新颖感到吃惊。

en.t: The pattern on this obi was drawn with such flamboyance and such vivid colors that I was astonished by how extraordinarily novel it felt.

units.source_text: 我心想，佐田先生怎么会画出这样美的图案来呢，因此全神贯注地欣赏……”

en.t: I wondered how Mr. Sada could have created such a beautiful design, and so I gazed at it with complete absorption..."
